# Description Clause

A root-local clause for authored descriptive content, independent of catalog, prices, parties, and workflows.

- `parameters.title`: the content title. Defaults to an empty string (`""`).
- `parameters.text`: the descriptive text. Defaults to an empty string (`""`).
- `parameters.sections`: optional sections. Defaults to an empty list (`[]`). Each section has a `title`, optional `text`, and optional `items` containing a list of text entries.

These parameters supply content only; changing them does not configure executable behavior. This clause declares no actions, guards, effects, or mutable state.
